response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for an ankle sprain that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers the costs of outpatient treatment, hospitalization, and prescribed medications resulting from an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, planned, or related to excluded activities (such as extreme sports, alcohol, or war/terrorism). Therefore, the claim is covered under the policy."}
